## {{< var wip >}} Python Interface

All the command line functionality can be called from Python. A few examples are given below. Note that all examples assume the following import convention:

```python
import seedcase_flower as fl
```

### Examples

```python
fl.view(path="https://...")
```
Views the metadata for a Data Package located online in the terminal

---

```python
fl.build()
```

Builds a documentation site in qmd format for the data package in the
current working directory.

---

```python
fl.build(
    path="my-folder/datapackage.json",
    config=fl.Config(
        style="quarto-resource-listings",
        ci="quarto"
    )
)
```

Builds a documentation site in qmd format for the data package in
`my-folder/datapackage.json`. The chosen style splits the documentation
into several pages. Template files are included for setting up
continuous integration with quarto on github.

---

```python
fl.build(
    config=fl.Config(
        style="custom",
        content=[["package"], ["contributors", "licenses"]]
        template=["1st-page.html", "2nd-page.html"]
    )
)
```

Builds a documentation site in html format for the data package in the
current working directory. The custom style of the documentation creates
one page with the package metadata and a second page with info on the
contributors and license. Both pages are created using a custom HTML
template.
